listenings.text: Good morning, passengers. This is an announcement for flight BA two four seven, to London. We have a change today. The flight is not at gate twelve. The new gate is gate twenty-two, and it is at the end of the terminal, on your left. Boarding starts at nine forty, and the gate closes at ten fifteen. Please have your passport and your boarding pass in your hand. Passengers with small children can board first. Thank you, and have a very good flight.

Hello, and welcome to the check-in area. Please have your ticket and your passport ready before you come to the desk. You can put one bag in the hold, and you can take one small bag with you on the plane. If your bag is more than twenty-three kilos, there is an extra cost. The line on the left is for families with children, and it is faster today. If you do not understand something, please ask any person with a blue jacket. We are here to help you. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: Good morning. Here is my ticket and my passport. I have two bags. Where is the gate, please? What time is boarding? Thank you very much.

paras: Welcome to Terminal 3. Please read this before you go to the desk. Check-in opens three hours before your flight and closes one hour before your flight.
At the desk you give your ticket and your passport. You can put one bag in the hold. This bag can be twenty-three kilos, not more. You can take one small bag with you on the plane.

After check-in you have your boarding pass. On the boarding pass you have three important things: your flight number, your gate and your seat. Please look at the screens, because sometimes the gate is not the same.
The line for families with small children is on the left, and it is faster. If you need help, ask a person with a blue jacket. We speak English slowly for our visitors, and we are happy to repeat.
